ownership: context rooted token; native weak handle and weak widget; never pins state, widget, animation, legacy player
lifetime: finish or NativeDestruct revokes lease permanently, including later replay/reconstruction; expired/torn-down weak state also invalid
reload: context destruction removes native callbacks without capturing VM or DAS closures; new VM globals reset
queries: is_valid and is_playing return false for default/expired/revoked handles
storage: DAS globals/arrays/clone allowed; native input, ue_property/defaults and native containers closed
validation: constructed widget in current game world; valid animation asset; finite nonnegative time, positive speed, nonnegative loops; normal enum/signature/direction guards
capacity: shared snapshot table bounded to 4096; GC prunes leases and unsubscribes native hooks
